# Billing specs

Invoices need a session: spec:auth:session/sign-in#valid-password
Own space: spec:billing:invoices/create
Missing in auth: spec:auth:session/logout
Renamed in auth: spec:auth:session/login
Only in an open auth change: spec:auth:session/two-factor
Open auth change: spec:auth:change/add-2fa
Not a local root: spec:identity:users/profile
